description: This file contains test utility classes and methods for SPDY stream testing in the Chromium project, including delegate implementations for handling stream events and data.

classes.name: ClosingDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class handling stream closure and header events.

classes.name: StreamDelegateBase
classes.description: Base class for stream event handling, managing stream state and data.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDoNothing
classes.description: Delegate that performs no actions on stream events.

classes.name: StreamDelegateConsumeData
classes.description: Delegate that consumes incoming data without processing.

classes.name: StreamDelegateSendImmediate
classes.description: Delegate that sends data immediately upon headers reception.

classes.name: StreamDelegateWithBody
classes.description: Delegate that sends a predefined body of data.

classes.name: StreamDelegateCloseOnHeaders
classes.description: Delegate that cancels the stream upon receiving headers.

classes.name: StreamDelegateDetectEOF
classes.description: Delegate that detects EOF when no more data is received.

methods.name: OnEarlyHintsReceived
methods.description: Called when early hints are received.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Called when the stream is closed.

methods.name: CanGreaseFrameType
methods.description: Indicates if frame type can be greased.

methods.name: source_dependency
methods.description: Returns the source dependency for logging.

methods.name: TakeReceivedData
methods.description: Retrieves all received data as a string.

methods.name: GetResponseHeaderValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a response header by name.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the stream with an error code.
